publicPrivileges: NONE on AFEX schemas, tables, sequences, views and sensitive functions; language/platform defaults outside AFEX scope remain platform-managed.

schemas.authenticated: USAGE only where Data API requires it; object grants enumerated below

schemas.access: afex_core_owner and exact internal runtime only

retainedReads: catalog_items: active rows in trusted tenant
branch_catalog_items: rows in trusted authorized branch

browserDatabasePrivileges.authenticated: NONE on public.profiles and any profile view

profilesPresentationModel.caller: verified authenticated browser session through one shared trusted authorization/account context; no per-page profile lookup
profilesPresentationModel.serverAuthoritySource: full public.profiles row may be read only through an exact server-only gateway/wrapper inside the existing trusted authorization/account route boundary; a user-bound authenticated Supabase server client is not sufficient
profilesPresentationModel.subjectIdentity: verified Auth session only; not projected from profiles
profilesPresentationModel.writeRule: all profile self-service writes remain denied
profilesPresentationModel.authorizationRule: browser projection and ui_capabilities are presentation only; every protected route re-resolves full trusted authority server-side
profilesPresentationModel.columnSecrecy: enforced by trusted server serialization allowlist, never by RLS

underlyingPrivileges.trustedServerGateway: exact SELECT needed by the full authorization-context lookup; never returned directly and never inherited by browser roles

inventoryMovementAccessModel.databaseCaller: trusted server gateway only; never shipped to the browser
inventoryMovementAccessModel.tenantPredicate: tenant_id equals the trusted server authorization-context tenant
inventoryMovementAccessModel.branchPredicate: assigned scope is pinned to its trusted branch; tenant-wide admin may request a branch only inside the trusted tenant

underlyingPrivileges.authenticated: NONE on public.inventory_movements, public.inventory_movements_view and the view's dependency closure

trustedServerGateway.rule: exact server-side reachability only; no browser membership; future view definition must remove whole-row to_jsonb references so this column list is complete and enforceable before ACL closure

inventoryMovementAccessModel.rlsBehavior: base RLS remains forced/closed for browser roles; trusted server gateway bypass is not treated as authorization and the route must apply trusted tenant/branch predicates
inventoryMovementAccessModel.dataApiExposure: base table and view are unreachable to browser roles; only the Next.js response is browser-visible
inventoryMovementAccessModel.rollback: disable the route or serve the last safely cached page; never restore browser base/view privileges
inventoryMovementAccessModel.compatibility: preserve the existing response allowlist and filters; initialize a 30-day window and allow bounded historical windows before privilege closure

sequences.rule: function-only; no PUBLIC/anon/authenticated or direct service-role privilege
objects: official order/invoice sequences and order_number_sequences backing identities

views.mode: security_invoker retained only as a server-side implementation detail
views.caller: trusted Next.js inventory-history route through the trusted server gateway
views.browserPrivileges: NONE for PUBLIC, anon and authenticated
views.underlyingPrivilegeRule: the trusted server gateway has the exact per-relation column reachability enumerated in inventoryMovementAccessModel; authenticated has neither view nor base privileges; whole-row expressions must be removed before exact column grants are applied

views.caller: trusted server only; no full pos_profiles exposure

defaultPrivileges.functions: no PUBLIC execution; later grants exact signature only
defaultPrivileges.types: no browser use unless explicitly required

serviceRoleRule: RLS bypass is assumed; each wrapper or route must independently validate trusted tenant/branch/actor/device/generations. service_role receives no blanket base-table ACL as an authority shortcut. The inventory-history route receives only its exact reviewed server-side read reachability.
columnSecrecyRule: RLS is row authorization only. Browser-visible columns are limited by trusted server serialization or an independently reviewed exact column grant; no target claim relies on RLS to hide columns.
postChangeProof: view grants and security_invoker underlying reachability
